dashboard.label: TA-sensors Overview
dashboard.description: Live Linux hwmon (lm-sensors) health on BMC-less hosts: fleet headline stats from the latest per-host snapshot, the full sensor value matrix, and alarmed sensors (hwmon _alarm latches).

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" app="TA-sensors" [| rest /services/server/info | eval host=splunk_server | fields host] earliest=-3h | stats latest(status) as st | eval value=if(st=="active","Licensed","Unlicensed") | table value

panel.html: This host is licensed for TA-sensors. Thanks for supporting BentleyPC development!

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-sensors requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-sensors", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-sensors/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click "Open License Setup page" to paste your key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M"), setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" | append [ | makeresults | eval host="this deployment", status="no data yet", note="beacon reports hourly once a key is set", last_reported="n/a", setup="Open License Setup page - paste your key" ] | table host status last_reported note setup | sort host
index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | dedup host | stats count(host) as value

index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"status\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | stats count(k) as value

panel.title: Max temperature (°C - fleet, latest per host)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"status\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"units\": \"celsius\"") | spath input=o output=t path=reading_value | stats max(t) as value

panel.title: Sensors in alarm (fleet, latest per host)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | eventstats latest(_time) as lt by host | dedup host lt | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"status\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | where match(o,"\"status\": \"alarm\"") | stats count(k) as value

panel.title: All sensors - latest value per host (one column per sensors.* metric)

search.query: | mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by host, metric_name span=5m | stats last(v*) as "v*" by host | rename v* as "sensors.*"

panel.title: Alarmed sensors - latest snapshot per host

search.query: index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | dedup host | rex field=_raw max_match=0 "\"(?<k>[^\"]+)\":\s*(?<o>\{[^{}]*\})" | where match(o,"\"status\": \"alarm\"") | eval z=mvzip(k,o,"^^") | mvexpand z | rex field=z "^(?<k>[^^]+)\^\^(?<o>.+)$" | spath input=o path=sensor_name | spath input=o path=reading | spath input=o path=reading_value | spath input=o path=units | table host k sensor_name reading reading_value units
index=main sourcetype="sensors:status" | stats latest(_time) as "Last seen", count(host) as "Reports" by host | table host "Last seen" "Reports" | sort - "Last seen"
